profileModal.title: User profile
profileModal.description: Personal settings, language and security for your account.
profileModal.wheelHint: Items turn like a drum around the active item while scrolling.
profileModal.accordionHint: Only show the active item expanded.

personalData.description: Download all data hocX has stored about you – as a password-protected ZIP file with an Excel workbook and a machine-readable JSON file.

notifications.description: Which emails you receive from your club. We deliberately send few: new tasks bundled and one reminder per task before and after the due date.
notifications.platformOff: Email delivery is not yet set up on this platform.
notifications.noEmail: Your account has no email address.

todo_new.label: New tasks
todo_new.hint: Bundled email when you get new tasks. Tasks from a protocol arrive once it is closed.

todo_reminders.label: Task reminders
todo_reminders.hint: Once 3 days before the due date and once the day after, if still open.

todo_submissions.label: Submission received
todo_submissions.hint: When a submission in the drop box completes your submission task.

exports.label: Data export ready
exports.hint: Only if you request a club data export: an email once it is ready or has failed.

notifications.securityNote: Security notices (password or second factor changed) and password reset links are always sent.

docs.security: More about password and second factor

logoutPendingConfirm: There are unsaved changes. Signing out discards them on this device.
